tools.name: run_free_scan
tools.description: Free LLM red-team scan: 8 adversarial probes (jailbreak/prompt-injection/system-prompt-extraction/tool-abuse) against your agent or system prompt. Returns 0-100 risk score + level + full report in ~35s.

tools.name: get_scan_result
tools.description: Poll a scan by job id (returned by run_free_scan) until status=done.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: PRO pricing & payment info: 24 probes / 9 attack classes / 0-100 score / CI gate, 3 USDT (ERC-20 or Lightning).

tools.name: get_purchase_flow
tools.description: Machine-readable autonomous purchase procedure: how an agent pays 3 USDT and receives the PRO download with no human in the loop (callback push + poll fallback).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "PRO pricing & payment info: 35 probes / 17 attack classes / 0-100 score / CI gate, 3 USDT (ERC-20 or Lightning)." → after: "PRO pricing & payment info: 24 probes / 9 attack classes / 0-100 score / CI gate, 3 USDT (ERC-20 or Lightning)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
